# HR Customer Profiles & Buying Logic

| Customer profile | Buying trigger | Evaluation evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Multi-site manufacturer | Bulk hiring, shifts, overtime, transfers and payroll complexity | Onboarding time, attendance exceptions, payroll reconciliation and cross-site reporting |
| Chain retailer or restaurant | Store dispersion, part-time workforce and frequent join/leave events | Mobile attendance, rapid onboarding, store-level accuracy and headquarters aggregation |
| Logistics or warehousing network | Field staff, branches, seasonal peaks and varied pay rules | Site coverage, exception handling, payroll closure and employee self-service |
| Hotel group | 24/7 operations, seasonal staffing and multiple properties | Scheduling, overtime, transfer and payroll processing time |
| IT or professional-services firm | Skilled hiring, hybrid work, goals and talent competition | Recruitment processing, OKR/KPI adoption, employee data quality and analytics |
